performance.scope: Unobserved canonical core, same seed/tick count; includes any change in physical trajectory/action mix. One process, no concurrent heavy task.

continuity.definition: Observed official-clock no-shot intervals, including half endpoints. Rotation v1 and Physical v1.1 trajectories are reported separately below. Diagnostic only; never a shot quota or proof of deadlock. A gap can span the period transition; halftime rest itself is outside official playing time.

commonObserver.definition: Same retained v1 observer in both stages; recycle is a broad reason-string action proxy and can overlap restarts.

intelligence.definition: Per-match diagnostic observations of recognized beaten episodes; distinct from the controlled free-carrier 40/40 acceptance.

endings.explanation: Shot-bearing attacks reconstructed exactly from canonical released-shot possession IDs. Historical remainder includes non-shot losses and period/procedural endings; raw result turnovers also include losses after earlier shots and are not a disjoint no-shot bucket.

definitions.endings: Exclusive ended canonical attacks; any released shot makes SHOT. Exact last-ending detail also retained.
definitions.continuations: Free throws and recycles are non-exclusive events within attacks, not lost possessions.
definitions.threat: DRIVE/FEINT/JUMP action starts separated by >600ms; JUMP+SHOOT is one motor threat. Observational proxy, no empirical time target.
definitions.secondAttack: New threat after observed defensive recovery/legal frontal stop and recycle; no guaranteed outcome.
